description: European Central Bank daily reference exchange rates for about 30 major currencies, from any base currency, latest or for a past date. Rates update once per working day; the response states which day. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

date.description: Past date YYYY-MM-DD; latest if omitted

symbols.description: Comma-separated target currencies; all if omitted
